minor_observations: Reconstruction error revised to use K-means within-cluster SS in 768D SVD-profile space instead of full Jacobian Frobenius norm. Avoids 1.1GB/block memory and is consistent with clustering.
GELU continuous Jacobians vs discrete ReLU regions: K-means imposes discretization. Null baseline is necessary but not sufficient to confirm discrete-like structure. Noted but not blocking.
